more_beautiful.reason: B has a warm, consistent palette of cream, dark brown, brass and seal red, well-paired serif headings and sans body text, a detailed pocket-watch illustration and clear section rhythm, while A is a sparse, cold pale-blue page with flat hierarchy and a few rough spots: a cramped 'about' heading, an empty strip below the ticket's tear line and a half-width question mark.

less_generic.reason: B has its own shop identity and details only this kind of shop would mention (陈记, a brass pocket watch showing the live time, 上海牌/海鸥牌, 'don't force-wind it' tips, a font-size enlarger for older visitors, cards for each of the three generations), even though its section layout is a familiar template; A's ticket-stub idea is nice, but its unnamed '修表铺' in generic blue mostly repeats the brief back word for word.
